title: Every worked-example project reads its greeting from the standard config path
description: Projects that apply the worked-example library declare a single acceptance criterion, load-bearing on the fixture only, so the doc's walkthrough has an end-to-end observable outcome to point at. The project reads the greeting string from the path exampleGreetingPath declared by the library-level ADR and echoes it on start.
rationale: The fixture exists to make library authoring concrete. A REQ that a real project could satisfy end-to-end (read a config, echo a string) keeps the example anchored to something a reader can imagine building, without pulling in domain complexity that would dilute the point (the library shape, not the greeting).
